info.name: Atlassian Admin Account Content Restrictions API

params.name: id
params.description: The ID of the content to be queried for its restrictions.

params.name: expand
params.description:
A multi-value parameter indicating which properties of the content
restrictions to expand. By default, the following objects are expanded:
`restrictions.user`, `restrictions.group`.

- `restrictions.user` returns the piece of content that the restrictions are
applied to.
- `restrictions.group` returns the piece of content that the restrictions are
applied to.
- `content` returns the piece of content that the restrictions are
applied to.

params.name: start
params.description: The starting index of the users and groups in the returned restrictions.

params.name: limit
params.description:
The maximum number of users and the maximum number of groups, in the
returned restrictions, to return per page. Note, this may be restricted
by fixed system limits.

items.docs:
Returns the restrictions on a piece of content.

**[Permissions](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/_AozKw) required**:
Permission to view the content.

params.name: id
params.description: The ID of the content to add restrictions to.

params.name: expand
params.description:
A multi-value parameter indicating which properties of the content
restrictions (returned in response) to expand.

- `restrictions.user` returns the piece of content that the restrictions are
applied to. Expanded by default.
- `restrictions.group` returns the piece of content that the restrictions are
applied to. Expanded by default.
- `content` returns the piece of content that the restrictions are
applied to.

items.docs:
Adds restrictions to a piece of content. Note, this does not change any
existing restrictions on the content.

**[Permissions](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/_AozKw) required**:
Permission to edit the content.

params.name: id
params.description: The ID of the content to update restrictions for.

params.name: expand
params.description:
A multi-value parameter indicating which properties of the content
restrictions (returned in response) to expand.

- `restrictions.user` returns the piece of content that the restrictions are
applied to. Expanded by default.
- `restrictions.group` returns the piece of content that the restrictions are
applied to. Expanded by default.
- `content` returns the piece of content that the restrictions are
applied to.

items.docs:
Updates restrictions for a piece of content. For each operation specified in the request, it removes
any existing restrictions on the content for that operation, and replaces them with the restrictions in the request.
Note: Not specifying an operation will ignore restrictions of that type, and passing an empty list for an operation
will remove all existing restrictions of that type.

Returns restrictions on a piece of content by operation. This method is
similar to [Get restrictions](#api-content-id-restriction-get) except that
the operations are properties of the return object, rather than items in
a results array.

**[Permissions](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/_AozKw) required**:
Permission to view the content.

params.description: The ID of the content that the restriction applies to.

params.name: operationKey
params.description: The operation that the restriction applies to.

params.name: groupName
params.description: The name of the group to add to the content restriction.

Deprecated, use [Add group to content restriction via groupId](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/confluence/rest/v1/api-group-content-restrictions/#api-wiki-rest-api-content-id-restriction-byoperation-operationkey-bygroupid-groupid-put).
Adds a group to a content restriction. That is, grant read or update
permission to the group for a piece of content.

**[Permissions](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/_AozKw) required**:
